claim: In the isotropic-depolarizing plus Ising-memory model of Apollaro, Lorenzo, Di Franco, Plastina, and Paternostro, let \(J\ne0\) be the Ising coupling, let \(\gamma=\gamma_0/|J|\ge0\) be the dimensionless depolarizing rate, and let \(z=|2B^{0}_{--}-1|\in[0,1]\) be the initial magnetization parameter of the memory-keeping spin. For the Luo–Fu–Song correlation-flow witness used in that paper, the exact Markovianity threshold is \[\gamma^*_{\mathrm{LFS}}(z)=\frac{1-z^2}{\sqrt{3(1+2z^2)}}.\]Equivalently, the LFS non-Markovianity is zero exactly for \(\gamma\ge\gamma^*_{\mathrm{LFS}}(z)\), and is positive for \(0\le\gamma<\gamma^*_{\mathrm{LFS}}(z)\). In dimensional form, \(\gamma_{0,\mathrm{LFS}}^*=|J|(1-z^2)/\sqrt{3(1+2z^2)}\). The universal threshold over all \(z\) is therefore \(1/\sqrt3=0.577350269\ldots\), attained at \(z=0\), which resolves the source's numerical value \(\gamma^*\approx0.6\). For \(0<z\le1\), this exact formula also gives \(\gamma^*_{\mathrm{LFS}}(z)\le\gamma^*_{\mathrm{LPP}}(z)=(1-z^2)/(3z)\), with equality only at \(z=1\), thereby analytically proving the LFS-versus-LPP portion of the numerical hierarchy reported by the source.

integrity.classification_basis: The claim is an open-quantum-system reduced-dynamics and decoherence result; primary MSC 81S22 is independently verified for mathematical literature on quantum Markovian dynamics.
integrity.computational_dependence: none for the proof; deterministic numerical replay is supplementary
integrity.novelty_scope: Exact analytic LFS threshold for a model whose source states that this threshold was evaluated numerically.
integrity.prior_work_preserved: The model, mutual-information rate, three other analytic thresholds, and numerical LFS hierarchy are credited to the cited sources.

scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the isotropic depolarizing plus single-spin Ising-memory specialization and the Luo–Fu–Song mutual-information witness.
Markovianity is witness-specific; the theorem does not assert CP divisibility or equality of the other non-Markovianity thresholds.
The amplitude-damping-plus-depolarizing extension and multi-spin memory environment are outside scope.
An equivalent formula may exist in unindexed literature or in a different parametrization.
title: Exact correlation-flow Markovianity threshold for the depolarizing–Ising competition model
